blocks.prompt: 5 (i) If \(x\) is so small that its cube and higher power can be neglected, show that \(\sqrt{1 - x - 2x^{2}} \approx 1 - \frac{1}{2}x - \frac{9}{8}x^{2}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa sirf \(x^{3}\) aur us se bari powers chhorni hain, yani \(x^{2}\) tak sab kuch rakhna hai.
Root ke andar 1 ke baad jo kuch hai, \(-x - 2x^{2}\), woh poora \((1 + y)^{1/2}\) ka \(y\) hai.
Dikhana kya hai? \(1 - \tfrac{1}{2}x - \tfrac{9}{8}x^{2}\).
Plan: \(y^{2}\) tak kholna, \(y\) rakhna, aur sirf \(x^{2}\) tak ki powers rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sqrt{1 - x - 2x^{2}}\), \(x^{3}\) va us se bari powers neglect.
Dikhana hai: \(\approx 1 - \frac{1}{2}x - \frac{9}{8}x^{2}\).
Tareeqa: \(x^{3}\) aur us se bari powers chhorni hain, is liye har series \(x^{2}\) wali term tak rakhi jayegi (yani teen terms), aur jo product \(x^{3}\) ya us se bari power de, woh chhor diya jayega.

Tayyari
\[\sqrt{1 - x - 2x^{2}} = (1 + y)^{1/2}\]
\[y = -x - 2x^{2}\]
Kyun: Bracket pehle hi 1 se shuru hai, is liye kuch bahar nahi nikalna. Baqi poora hissa ek hi \(y\) maan liya, taa ke formula seedha lag sake.

\(y^{2}\) tak kholein
\[(1 + y)^{1/2} \approx 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}y - \dfrac{1}{8}y^{2}\]
Kyun: \(n = \tfrac{1}{2}\) ke coefficients. \(y^{3}\) mein kam az kam \(x^{3}\) hoga, jo chhorna hai, is liye teen terms kaafi hain.

\(y^{2}\) nikalein
\[y^{2} = (x + 2x^{2})^{2}\]
\[= x^{2} + 4x^{3} + 4x^{4} \approx x^{2}\]
Kyun: Minus ka square plus hota hai, is liye \((-x - 2x^{2})^{2} = (x + 2x^{2})^{2}\). Kholne par sirf \(x^{2}\) bachta hai; \(x^{3}\) aur \(x^{4}\) chhor diye.
Dhyan dein: \(y^{2}\) ko sirf \(x^{2}\) samajh lena yahan theek hai, lekin \(\tfrac{1}{2}y\) mein \(-2x^{2}\) wala hissa zaroor rakhna hai, kyunke woh \(x^{2}\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.1:\ \sqrt{0.88} = 0.938083\]
\[1 - 0.05 - 0.01125 = 0.93875\]
Kyun: Farq takreeban 0.0007 hai, jo \(x^{3}\) (0.001) ke size ka hai, yani wohi hissa jo chhora gaya. Natija sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) If \(x\) is so small that its cube and higher power can be neglected, show that \(\sqrt{\frac{1 + x}{1 - x}} \approx 1 + x + \frac{1}{2}x^{2}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi \(x^{2}\) tak sab rakhna hai.
Root ke andar fraction hai, to usay \((1 + x)^{1/2}(1 - x)^{-1/2}\) likh sakte hain: do series ka product.
Dikhana kya hai? \(1 + x + \tfrac{1}{2}x^{2}\).
Plan: dono series teen teen terms tak, multiply, aur \(x^{2}\) tak ki powers jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sqrt{\frac{1 + x}{1 - x}}\), \(x^{3}\) va us se bari powers neglect.
Dikhana hai: \(\approx 1 + x + \frac{1}{2}x^{2}\).
Tareeqa: \(x^{3}\) aur us se bari powers chhorni hain, is liye har series \(x^{2}\) wali term tak rakhi jayegi (yani teen terms), aur jo product \(x^{3}\) ya us se bari power de, woh chhor diya jayega.

Product ki shakal
\[\sqrt{\dfrac{1 + x}{1 - x}} = (1 + x)^{1/2}(1 - x)^{-1/2}\]
Kyun: Root upar aur neeche dono par lagta hai: upar \((1 + x)^{1/2}\), aur neeche wala upar aa kar \((1 - x)^{-1/2}\).

Pehli series
\[(1 + x)^{1/2} \approx 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}x - \dfrac{1}{8}x^{2}\]
Kyun: \(n = \tfrac{1}{2}\): teesra coefficient \(\tfrac{\frac{1}{2}(-\frac{1}{2})}{2} = -\tfrac{1}{8}\).

Doosri series
\[(1 - x)^{-1/2} \approx 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}x + \dfrac{3}{8}x^{2}\]
Kyun: \(n = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) aur \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\). Doosri term: \((-\tfrac{1}{2})(-x) = +\tfrac{1}{2}x\). Teesri: \(\tfrac{(-\frac{1}{2})(-\frac{3}{2})}{2} = \tfrac{3}{8}\), aur \((-x)^{2} = x^{2}\) positive. Is liye saari terms plus.
Dhyan dein: \((1 - x)^{-1/2}\) ki saari terms positive aati hain. Agar aap ki series mein minus aa gaya to sign dobara check kijiye.

Multiply karein, \(x^{2}\) tak
\[x: \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2} = 1\]
\[x^{2}: \dfrac{3}{8} + \dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{1}{8} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\Rightarrow 1 + x + \dfrac{1}{2}x^{2}\]
Kyun: \(x\) do jagah se aata hai: \(1 \cdot \tfrac{1}{2}x\) aur \(\tfrac{1}{2}x \cdot 1\). \(x^{2}\) teen jagah se: \(1 \cdot \tfrac{3}{8}x^{2}\), \(\tfrac{1}{2}x \cdot \tfrac{1}{2}x = \tfrac{1}{4}x^{2}\), aur \(-\tfrac{1}{8}x^{2} \cdot 1\). Jama: \(\tfrac{3}{8} + \tfrac{2}{8} - \tfrac{1}{8} = \tfrac{4}{8} = \tfrac{1}{2}\).

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.1:\ \sqrt{\dfrac{1.1}{0.9}} = 1.105542\]
\[1 + 0.1 + 0.005 = 1.105\]
Kyun: Farq takreeban 0.0005 hai, jo chhori hui \(x^{3}\) wali term ke size ka hai. Natija sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\sqrt{\frac{1 + x}{1 - x}} \approx 1 + x + \frac{1}{2}x^{2}\). Saabit ho gaya.
